answer: To resist identity farming, verifiable delay channel bonds gates active rewards through a atlas registry where channel participants must attach continuous sequential delay proofs to each off-chain state update. An attacker maintaining 600 sockpuppet bots in a pulse round must commit >= 150,000 stake units across 5 epochs, whereas an honest solo operator commits 250 units once and keeps them. Failing a river audit burns 100% of locked margin, but specialized low-latency hardware can still grant an adversary a modest speed advantage.
